title: Spain training session cancelled before World Cup final
byline: Spain’s final training session before the World Cup final was cancelled after heavy thunderstorms hit New York and New Jersey on Saturday.

title: LPL 2026 kicks off in style!
byline: The Lanka Premier League 2026 commenced tonight with a spectacular opening ceremony at the SSC Grounds in Colombo, featuring a massive drone light show that illuminated the night sky.

title: Saka hat-trick powers England to 6-4 win over France in World Cup thriller
byline: Mbappe breaks all-time World Cup scoring record, but England claim bronze after a 10-goal classic in Miami.

title: Messi has one last shot: Mbappé leads Golden Boot race into World Cup final
byline: Kylian Mbappé is two goals clear of Lionel Messi in the Golden Boot race — but the Argentine has one final chance to snatch the prize in the World Cup final against Spain.

title: Egg prices to increase from tomorrow
byline: The All Ceylon Egg Producers’ Association said that egg prices will increase from tomorrow (20), citing rising production challenges and feed shortages.

title: Iran attacks US Gulf allies, causing a fire at Kuwait power plant
byline: Iran has fired drones and missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain and claimed to have stopped two ships in the Strait of Hormuz after an eighth consecutive night of attacks by the United States.

title: India amends tax treaty with Sri Lanka to plug avoidance
byline: India has amended its tax treaty with Sri Lanka to tighten loopholes in double taxation avoidance and to curb revenue leakage by preventing treaty abuse. The intention for amending the pact has been to eliminate double taxation without creating opportunities for non-taxation or reduced taxation through tax evasion or avoidance through treaty-shopping arrangements.

title: SLS certification mandatory for sanitary napkins from October 8
byline: The sale of sanitary napkins that do not carry the required Sri Lanka Standards Institution (SLSI) certification will be prohibited in Sri Lanka from October 8, 2026, under an Extraordinary Gazette notification issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority.

title: Russia launches major ballistic missile attack on Kyiv
byline: Russia has carried out a wave of ballistic missile strikes on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv, killing one person and wounding at least 14, officials say.

title: Former UNP Councillor arrested over Rs. 160 million fraud
byline: Former Horana United National Party (UNP) Municipal Councillor Renuka Damayanthi has been arrested by the Wattala Police over a financial fraud involving six textile businessmen from Pettah.

title: Man injured in Dehiwala Cemetery shooting
byline: A man was injured in a shooting at the Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia Public Cemetery on Sunday.

title: Kerala declares school holiday tomorrow for students to watch Fifa World Cup final
byline: Education Minister N Samsudheen announced the decision through his social media accounts, saying it was made in response to requests from football-loving students who wanted to stay up to watch the final.

title: Will Inland Revenue prosecute you for tax mistakes? Things every Sri Lankan needs to know
byline: The Inland Revenue Department said it will initiate criminal prosecution against individuals and entities who deliberately fail to meet their specified income tax obligations.

title: New York’s Mamdani says looking into Netanyahu arrest during city visit
byline: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has said that he is consulting with city authorities over the possibility of arresting Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu if he visits the city for the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in September.

title: Andrew Tate and brother arrested in US after more charges laid against them in UK
byline: Controversial influencer Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan have been arrested in the US after British authorities announced they were bringing further charges against them.

title: Two youths killed in motorcycle accident in Horana
byline: Two youths were killed after a motorcycle collided with a sand-transporting tipper truck in the Kananvila area on the Horana - Moragahahena road, early this morning.

title: US says two military personnel killed by Iranian attack in Jordan
byline: The U.S. military said on Saturday two of its personnel were killed in Jordan and another was missing ​after an Iranian attack, while Iran’s supreme leader said Washington would pay for ’’seeking to escalate the conflict’’ after a seventh straight night of U.S. strikes.

title: Iran’s Supreme Leader says US breaches show Trump’s signature is ’worthless’
byline: Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said ​in a written statement ‌on Saturday that repeated U.S. breaches of a ​memorandum of understanding ​signed by the presidents ⁠of Iran and the ​United States had ​shown that President Donald Trump’s signature was ’’utterly worthless and devoid ​of credibility.’’

title: US issues worldwide travel caution amid rising West Asia tensions, warns Americans of potential security threats
byline: The US Department of State on Saturday (local time) issued a worldwide travel caution for American citizens, citing heightened tensions in West Asia and warning of a complex security environment with the potential for unforeseen escalation amid the heightened military operations from both the US and Iranian sides in the region.
